scope: One bounded Chisel instance composes real R3 publication, the frozen verification join, C1 typed packed source delivery and sidecar fixture, static functional R4 terminal, real R6 retirement, and same-R5 reclaim. It adds stale-response suppression plus fresh dual-R1 init acknowledgement after reset; it does not activate production hardware.

boundary.composition: testbench-only same-instance R3 publication through C1 typed source delivery, static R4 terminal, R6 retirement, and same-R5 reclaim
boundary.source_read: RTL3.2 association owner plus typed R2/R1 endpoint chain
boundary.reset: both test-harness R1 wrappers require fresh external init_ack; unmatched old response is consumed-and-suppressed

invariants: real publication precedes S2 service join
sidecar is copied-allocation fixture data only
S2 READY requires payload and sidecar completion
all four static packets accepted before static terminal
R6 owns terminal retirement and same R5 owns reclaim
stale response consumed-and-suppressed before fresh init_ack

chisel_commands: cd hardware/route_a/chisel && sbt -batch 'testOnly kvpress.routea.rtl2.RouteARTL265eSameInstanceWitnessSpec -- -z "rejects a stale C2 response"'
